name: Santa María del Tiétar (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santa María del Tiétar (roundels on blue and a crescent on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 6 June 1995 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 123 of 28 June 1995); the flag is square of proportion 1:1, quartered blue and white, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.

features.role: Santa María del Tiétar arms — roundels and crescent
